options.name: attributes
options.description: List of attribute names separated by ',' which needs to be fetched from ldap server. Note that preceeding and trailing spaces will be removed. Attribute name can be 127 bytes and total length of this string should not cross 2047 bytes. These attributes have multi-value support separated by ',' and stored as key-value pair in AAA session

options.name: authentication
options.description: Perform LDAP authentication. If authentication is disabled, any LDAP authentication attempt returns authentication success if the user is found. CAUTION! Authentication should be disabled only for authorization group extraction or where other (non-LDAP) authentication methods are in use and either bound to a primary list or flagged as secondary.

options.name: authtimeout
options.description: Number of seconds the Citrix ADC waits for a response from the RADIUS server.

options.name: cloudattributes
options.description: The Citrix ADC uses the cloud attributes to extract additional attributes from LDAP servers required for Citrix Cloud operations

options.name: defaultauthenticationgroup
options.description: This is the default group that is chosen when the authentication succeeds in addition to extracted groups.

options.name: email
options.description: The Citrix ADC uses the email attribute to query the Active Directory for the email id of a user

options.name: followreferrals
options.description: Setting this option to C(ON) enables following LDAP referrals received from the LDAP server.

options.name: groupattrname
options.description: LDAP group attribute name. Used for group extraction on the LDAP server.

options.name: groupnameidentifier
options.description: Name that uniquely identifies a group in LDAP or Active Directory.

options.name: groupsearchattribute
options.description: LDAP group search attribute. Used to determine to which groups a group belongs.

options.name: groupsearchfilter
options.description: String to be combined with the default LDAP group search string to form the search value.  For example, the group search filter ""vpnallowed=true"" when combined with the group identifier ""samaccount"" and the group name ""g1"" yields the LDAP search string ""(&(vpnallowed=true)(samaccount=g1)"". If nestedGroupExtraction is ENABLED, the filter is applied on the first level group search as well, otherwise first level groups (of which user is a direct member of) will be fetched without applying t

options.name: groupsearchsubattribute
options.description: LDAP group search subattribute. Used to determine to which groups a group belongs.

options.name: kbattribute
options.description: KnowledgeBasedAuthentication(KBA) attribute on AD. This attribute is used to store and retrieve preconfigured Question and Answer knowledge base used for KBA authentication.

options.name: ldapbase
options.description: Base (node) from which to start LDAP searches. If the LDAP server is running locally, the default value of base is dc=netscaler, dc=com.

options.name: ldapbinddn
options.description: Full distinguished name (DN) that is used to bind to the LDAP server. Default: cn=Manager,dc=netscaler,dc=com

options.name: ldapbinddnpassword
options.description: Password used to bind to the LDAP server.

options.name: ldaphostname
options.description: Hostname for the LDAP server.  If -validateServerCert is ON then this must be the host name on the certificate from the LDAP server. A hostname mismatch will cause a connection failure.

options.name: ldaploginname
options.description: LDAP login name attribute. The Citrix ADC uses the LDAP login name to query external LDAP servers or Active Directories.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxldapreferrals
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of nested referrals to follow.

options.name: maxnestinglevel
options.description: If nested group extraction is ON, specifies the number of levels up to which group extraction is performed.

options.name: mssrvrecordlocation
options.description: MSSRV Specific parameter. Used to locate the DNS node to which the SRV record pertains in the domainname. The domainname is appended to it to form the srv record. Example : For "dc._msdcs", the srv record formed is _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.<domainname>.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the new LDAP action. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore character (_), and must contain only letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-), period (.) pound (#), space ( ), at (@), equals (=), colon (:), and underscore characters. Cannot be changed after the LDAP action is added.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my authentication action" or '

options.name: nestedgroupextraction
options.description: Allow nested group extraction, in which the Citrix ADC queries external LDAP servers to determine whether a group is part of another group.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: otpsecret
options.description: OneTimePassword(OTP) Secret key attribute on AD. This attribute is used to store and retrieve secret key used for OTP check

options.name: passwdchange
options.description: Allow password change requests.

options.name: pushservice
options.description: Name of the service used to send push notifications

options.name: referraldnslookup
options.description: Specifies the DNS Record lookup Type for the referrals

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: requireuser
options.description: Require a successful user search for authentication. CAUTION!  This field should be set to C(NO) only if usersearch not required [Both username validation as well as password validation skipped] and (non-LDAP) authentication methods are in use and either bound to a primary list or flagged as secondary.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: searchfilter
options.description: String to be combined with the default LDAP user search string to form the search value. For example, if the search filter "vpnallowed=true" is combined with the LDAP login name "samaccount" and the user-supplied username is "bob", the result is the LDAP search string ""&(vpnallowed=true)(samaccount=bob)"" (Be sure to enclose the search string in two sets of double quotation marks; both sets are needed.).

options.name: sectype
options.description: Type of security used for communications between the Citrix ADC and the LDAP server. For the C(PLAINTEXT) setting, no encryption is required.

options.name: serverip
options.description: IP address assigned to the LDAP server.

options.name: servername
options.description: LDAP server name as a FQDN.  Mutually exclusive with LDAP IP address.

options.name: serverport
options.description: Port on which the LDAP server accepts connections.

options.name: sshpublickey
options.description: SSH PublicKey is attribute on AD. This attribute is used to retrieve ssh PublicKey for RBA authentication

options.name: ssonameattribute
options.description: LDAP single signon (SSO) attribute. The Citrix ADC uses the SSO name attribute to query external LDAP servers or Active Directories for an alternate username.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: subattributename
options.description: LDAP group sub-attribute name. Used for group extraction from the LDAP server.

options.name: svrtype
options.description: The type of LDAP server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: validateservercert
options.description: When to validate LDAP server certs
